office: the Parliamentary Elections Office (PEO), at the constituency offices

routes.label: registration at the constituency office; the card in about two weeks

note: The PEO's registration page: registration is at the constituency office only; the card is ready in about two weeks; the initial application is free, a replacement EC$20 (not modelled). The voter's card is kept as Grenada's identity card, no other national card having been found; 18 is kept as the age of an elector. The card's term isn't on the page.

sources.title: Parliamentary Elections Office (Grenada), Registration
sources.said: Following registration, voters can expect to receive their Voter’s Identification Card within approximately two weeks. The initial application is free, while replacement cards cost EC$20.00.
